title: Remove the stale R-GA-boot skip on gamification_p0_test.dart E2E-601 — the bug it cites is already fixed
area: test/e2e/journeys/gamification_p0_test.dart (E2E-601 — parent creates a reward, child redeems it)
why: The skip's doc-comment says bootstrap() runs synchronously inside initState and trips Riverpod's build-phase-mutation guard. That was true when the test was authored (commit d89bbb41, 2026-06-19 07:55) but commit 7bfc3669 landed the same day at 11:24 titled '...defer reward bootstrap (R-PR10, R-GA-boot)' — it moved the bootstrap() call into WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback, the exact bug this skip cites. I removed the skip locally and ran `flutter test --plain-name E2E-601`: the app navigated past RestoreGuard/ProfileGuard into RewardConfigurationScreen with zero Riverpod build-phase exception, proving the cited bug does not reproduce. (It then hit an unrelated `find.text('Save Reward')` "Too many elements" StateError inside scrollUntilVisible, so the group needs a small fix, not just an unskip.) Net effect: E2E-601 — the file's #1-listed journey and the catalog's P0 'parent creates reward / child redeems it' scenario — has had zero active coverage for about two weeks, silently, because the doc comment describing why it's skipped no longer describes the code.
recommendation: Delete the stale skip and its doc-comment (file header lines 4-5 and group lines 196-209), disambiguate the Save Reward finder (add a Key or `.first`), and get E2E-601 green so the P0 happy path is exercised again.
acceptance_criteria: File header doc-comment no longer lists E2E-601 as 'SKIP — BUG R-GA-boot'
make ci / make test-all-stories runs this group as part of the normal suite
